text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: As {0} walked through the bustling streets of Landosol, a familiar girl's roar suddenly reached his ears... but then...
text_block_list.orig_text:
多くの人が行き交うランドソルの街中を歩いていた
{0}の耳に、聞き慣れた少女の
咆哮が聞こえてきた……
のだが──

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: SPIRESBANE BLAAAAAADE!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: 天楼覇断剣～！！！

text_block_list.name: Man 1 & Man 2
text_block_list.text: GYAAAAAHHHHHHHHHHHHHH!!!
text_block_list.orig_text: ぎゃああああああ～っ！！！

text_block_list.name: Woman
text_block_list.text: What was that just now?! Someone was blown away...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
何よ今の！？　
人が吹き飛ばされてったんだけど……！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Guess I'll leave it at that! Heh heh! Had enough?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
こんなとこにしとくか。
ふふん、
どうだ！　
参ったか！

text_block_list.name: Man 1 & Man 2
text_block_list.text: W-WE GIVE UP!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
参りましたぁぁぁ～！

text_block_list.name: Male 1
text_block_list.text: Enough of this! We understand! It's our fault!
text_block_list.orig_text: もういいですわかりましたオレたちが悪かったですぅ～！

text_block_list.name: Male 2
text_block_list.text: We're so sorry for trying to extort money from you!
text_block_list.orig_text: カツアゲなんてしてすみませんでした～！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Good! If you're truly remorseful, I'll forgive you! From now on, leave the villainy to the real bad guys and do some good!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おう！　
反省してるなら許してやる！
これからは悪いヤツにならずに、
いいヤツになれよな！

text_block_list.name: Man 1 & Man 2
text_block_list.text: Yes~!
text_block_list.orig_text: はいぃ～！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hm...? Ohhh! {0}! How have you been? All fine over here!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん……？　
おお！　
{0}～！
元気にしてたか？　
アタシは元気だぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'm sure it's fine! I went easy on those two, see? ...Although I don't know how well that worked!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それなら大丈夫だ！　
手加減したに決まってるだろ？
……どれくらいできてたかは分からないけどな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'm sure they'll be fine. They're still alive, at least. But more importantly! What are you up to?
text_block_list.orig_text:
平気なんじゃないか？　
一応ちゃんと生きてたし。
それよりだ！　
オマエは何やってんだ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Help... ME? Haha! You really are a good guy!
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシをか？
ははっ！　
やっぱりオマエはいいヤツだな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'm not the kind of weakling who'd let those lowlives get the better of her! But thanks anyway! Your kind thoughts are enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あんなヤツらにやられるアタシじゃないぞ！
でも
ありがとな！　
気持ちだけで十分だ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I've been traveling around, fighting bad guys like I just did! If I keep defeating them, someday I'll become the greatest villain in the world!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あちこち旅しながら、
さっきみたいに悪いヤツと戦ってたぞ！
悪いヤツを倒していけば、
いつか世界で一番悪いヤツになれるからな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: And also... I'm looking for a monster! The incredibly strong and dangerous kind! If you know of any, please let me know! Thanks!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それとあとは……
魔物を探してるな！
めちゃくちゃ強くてヤバいヤツだ！
なんか情報があれば教えてくれ！　
よろしく頼む！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Though I guess it wouldn't be fair if I were the only one asking favors. Hey, is there something I can help you with?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……アタシがお願いするだけっていうのもあれだな。
なあ、
アタシにしてほしいことはないか？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Yeah. You've fought by my side so many times. I owe you one.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ。
オマエには何回も一緒に戦ってもらった恩がある。
だから恩返しがしたいんだ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That's more or less it. Let me know if you need anything!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうわけだ。
何かあれば言ってくれ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I see! See you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そっか！　
じゃあまたな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: WAIT, YOU LIAR! There's GOTTA be something! Some kind of trouble, even small!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ってウソつけぇ！　
あるだろなんか！
困ってることとかさぁ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Come on! Shake your head around! Maybe you'll remember something! ...Hmmm? How'd it go? Anything came to mind?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ほら
頭振ってみたりして思い出してみろ！
……
どうだ？　
出てきたか？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...No? Are you sure there's nothing? Kokkoro takes care of most of your personal needs...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
……ない？　
本当にないのか？
身の回りの世話は
コッコロが大体やってくれてる？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: That's not what I meant. Something like... "Oh the world's in a pinch"! Knowing you, you're probably caught in some weird scheme from a good-for-nothing baddie!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのじゃなくて、
もっとこう……
世界のピンチみたいなヤツだよ！　
オマエのことだし、
またロクでもないヤツの悪だくみに巻き込まれてるはずだ！

text_block_list.name: ムイミ
text_block_list.text:
……なんか今のアタシ、
カツアゲしてるみたいじゃないか？
ダメだダメだ！　
別にコイツを困らせたいわけじゃないのに！
text_block_list.orig_text:
……なんか今のアタシ、
カツアゲしてるみたいじゃないか？
ダメだダメだ！　
別にコイツを困らせたいわけじゃないのに！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Never mind! Forget what I just said! I started to feel like I'm the villain here...
text_block_list.orig_text:
やっぱいいや！　
今のは忘れてくれ！
これじゃあアタシが悪いヤツみたいだ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...Then again, maybe that's fine. I am supposed to be a villain...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……いや、
いいのか？
アタシは悪いヤツだし……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Hmm... Huh? Hey! Where are you going? Don't tell me you're trying to run away from me...
text_block_list.orig_text:
うーん……
ん？　
おい！　
どこ行くんだー？
ひょっとしてアタシから逃げるなんて言うんじゃ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: YOU ARE?! Okay, I've changed my mind! I'm not letting you go until you tell me what's bothering you! I'm a villain after all!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうなのか！？　
よーし、
気が変わった！
オマエに困ってること教えてもらえるまで帰さないぞ！
やっぱりアタシは悪いヤツだからな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Come on! Spit it out already! The sooner you talk, the easier this'll be!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おらっ！　
とっとと吐け！
早い方が楽になれるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh?! What is it? Tell me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
おおっ！？　
なんだなんだ？　
教えてくれ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I see, sounds tough! ...Hey, you were referring to me just now, were you? Even I could tell that much!
text_block_list.orig_text:
そうか、
大変だな！
……おい。
アタシのことだな今の！
さすがに分かったぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Oh well... I was hoping you'd be in some trouble since it always seems the case with you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
なーんだ……
オマエってよく面倒なことになってるから
なんかあればって思ったのにな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: So nothing's happening right now... Well, that's probably for the best. Peace is nice...
text_block_list.orig_text:
今はなんにもなしか……
まあその方がいいよな。
平和が一番だよな……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I got it! Leave it to me then! I'll be counting on you from now on! ...Alright, let's do this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かった！　
それならまかせろ！
じゃあ今からよろしくな！
……よーし、
やるぞー！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: ...What's wrong? You wonder what I mean with "from now on"...? Don't worry! I'll simply stay with you for a while!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……どうした？　
これからって
「今から」だろ？
安心しろ！　
しばらくアタシが一緒についてってやるぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If I'm alongside you, someone accustomed to finding people in need, it'll be easy to spot bad guys! It's perfect!
text_block_list.orig_text:
困ってるヤツを見つけるのが得意なオマエといれば、
悪いヤツも見つけやすくなるし
ちょうどいいな！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Let's go! To find those in trouble and the ones bothering them... we shall set off!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
いくぞ！　
困ってるヤツと悪いヤツ探しに出発だ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: By the way... how do you always find people in trouble?
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういえば……
オマエってさ、
いつもどうやって困ってるヤツを見つけるんだ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'd love to find lots of bad guys like you do. But it's hard because they do evil things sneakily.
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシもオマエみたいにたくさん悪党を見つけたいんだよ。
でもアイツらは
隠れて悪さするから難しくてさ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Obviously, if I want to become the greatest villain by beating up bad guys, I need bad guys to beat up.
text_block_list.orig_text:
当たり前だけど、
悪党をやっつける大悪党には、
悪さをする相手がいないとなれないんだ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: In that respect, being a good person is great because you can become one in many different ways, even without a partner.
text_block_list.orig_text:
その点いいヤツってのは
相手がいなくても、
いろんなやり方でなれるのがいいよな。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: For example... picking up trash and cleaning up the road for someone else. Doing something like that for yourself will also benefit someone else, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
たとえば……
誰かのためにゴミを拾って道路をキレイにするとかさ。
そういうのは自分のためにやったって、
誰かのためにもなるだろ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: And even though you're a hero who saved this world, you still want to help people in need. That's really admirable!
text_block_list.orig_text:
しかもオマエはこっちの世界を救った英雄なのに、
今でも困ってる人を助けたいんだな。
すごい立派だぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Don't sell yourself short! You ARE admirable!
text_block_list.orig_text:
自分から自分を小さく見せようとするなよ！
オマエは立派だぞ！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: If you're too humble, some bad guys will leverage it to use you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
そういうのはほどほどにしておかないと
悪いヤツにつけ込まれて利用されるぞ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I've always made myself look as big and impressive as possible!...
text_block_list.orig_text:
アタシは昔からでっかく見せてきたんだ。
それでも──

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: Hah...
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Huh? You mean that old man? He's just standing there in front of the house, right?
text_block_list.orig_text:
は？　
あの人って
あのおっちゃんか？
家の前で突っ立ってるだけだよな？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Ah! Hey! Wait for me! Don't start running all of a sudden!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ！　
おい！　
待てって！
いきなり走りだすなよな～！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: What's with you guys...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
なんだ、
君たちは……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Is there anything troubling you, old man? This guy's kind of perceptive about others worries.
text_block_list.orig_text:
おっちゃん、
なんか困ってることないか？
コイツは
そういう勘が利くヤツなんだ！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: Ah, I was indeed at my wit's end... And please stop calling me "old man". I'm still in my twenties.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ああ、
確かに困り果てていたところだよ……
あとおっちゃんはやめてくれ。
まだ20代だ。

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: I'm in charge of the redevelopment of this entire area, and all that's left is to demolish this mansion.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私は
この区画一帯を整理する工事を取り仕切っていて、
残るは
この豪邸を解体するだけなんだ。

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: However, some of the craftsmen got sick and couldn't come in the middle of the work... The next stage is scheduled to start tomorrow, but there's no other available craftsmen around.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ところが
作業途中で職人たちが病気でこれなくなってね……
次の工程が
明日始まる予定だけど、
他の職人は
手が空いてないときた。

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: I was at a loss, thinking, "Now I have to demolish this huge house all by myself..."
text_block_list.orig_text:
今から一人でだだっ広い家の解体か……
と、
途方に暮れていたのさ。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Sounds tough... I mean, you really are something, {0}...! I would have just walked right past him...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大変だな……
っていうかオマエ、
ホントにすごいな……！
アタシだったら
普通に通り過ぎてたぞ……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: But this time, it doesn't look like you'll be able to help in some way. This house is ridiculously big, so I bet it's impossible to get it dismantled by the end of the day.
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも今回は、
オマエにどうにかできることじゃなさそうだな。
この家めちゃくちゃ広いし、
今日中に解体するのは無理じゃないか？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Heh... Yeah. I knew that's what you'd say.
text_block_list.orig_text:
……だよな。
オマエはやっぱそう言うよな。

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: I appreciate your kindness, but this can't be resolved by the two of us alone. The only choice left is to quietly postpone the construction schedule...
text_block_list.orig_text:
私も
君の善意には感謝したいが、
この場にいる私たちだけではとても終わらないよ。
大人しく
工期をずらすしかない……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Then leave it to me! Don't worry, you two!
text_block_list.orig_text:
だったらアタシにまかせろ！
安心していいぞ
二人とも！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: No need for thanks! Just knowing you appreciate it is enough!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちゃんはいらん！
気持ちだけ受け取っておいてやる！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: You can use magic? Otherwise, it's impossible. This house is scheduled for demolition by explosives, and the explosives have already been brought in. It won't be easy to demolish.
text_block_list.orig_text:
君は
魔法が使えるのか？　
そうでなければ不可能だ。
何せ
この家は爆破解体予定で、
爆薬を搬入してあるくらいだぞ。
簡単には解体できない。

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Magic? Nope! But I have this!
text_block_list.orig_text:
魔法？　
違うな、
アタシにはコイツがある！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: MANIFEST! SPIRESBANE BLAAAAAADE...!!!!
text_block_list.orig_text:
現出せよ、
天楼覇断剣──！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: A sword is coming from the ground! You're saying that's not magic...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
地面から剣が！
しかし
それはやはり魔法なのでは……

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Get away from me, you two! Blowing up a house like this is easy! And you've already got the explosives ready! ORYAAAAAAAAAH!
text_block_list.orig_text:
離れとけ二人とも！　
家くらい簡単にぶっ壊してやる！
ちょうど爆薬もあることだしな！　
うおりゃああああーっ！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: W-WAIT! At least check whether there's the right amount of explosives first!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ま、
待った！　
爆薬の量を確認してからでも──！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: What?
text_block_list.orig_text: えっ？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: DOOOOOHIIIIIIIIII!?
text_block_list.orig_text: どひーっ！！！！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: ARE YOU OKAY?! I knew this was gonna happen...! Ah, but the house collapsed. I guess that solves my problem... though I'm not sure I should be saying that right now...
text_block_list.orig_text:
大丈夫か～！？　
言わんこっちゃない……！
あ、
でも家はちゃんと崩れた。
助かった……
と言っていいのかこれは……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: I'LL BE FINE!
text_block_list.orig_text: アタシは大丈夫だー！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: {0}! I'm so glad I was able to help that person!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}ー！
その人を助けられてよかったなー！

text_block_list.name: Young man
text_block_list.text: She's talking as she's being blown away in the air... What's going on with your friend...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
吹き飛ばされながらしゃべってるぞあの子……
一体どうなっているんだ君の友達は……？

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Sureeee! See you later!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お～ぅ！　
またな～！！

text_block_list.name: Muimi
text_block_list.text: Being blown away like this reminds me of the time when I was fighting against {0} and the others... You never know what life's gonna throw at you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして吹っ飛んでると、
{0}たちと戦ってた頃を思い出すな……
人生何が起きるかなんて、
分かんないもんだな。

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: Perhaps because she'd been able to help someone in need, Muimi flew off into the distance with a bright smile on her face. {0} smiled and waved back as she disappeared from view.
text_block_list.orig_text:
──困っている人を助ける手伝いができたからなのか
晴れやかな笑顔で彼方へと吹き飛んでいくムイミに、
{0}もまた笑顔で手を振り返したのだった。
